2438-3175-8207.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5702-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-5702-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-967-1308-3809-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-7192.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2972-5456-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
2972-5456-7824.description:
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3457-6875-7791.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
3457-6875-7791.description:
Activate Raucous Audience by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Raucous Audience.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Raucous Audience.
Repeat.

3525-3711-6723.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7052-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7052-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4419-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

3175-4050-4775.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

2525-3763-3967-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2525-3763-3967-6749.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

283-950-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
283-950-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting that ability.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers. Holding priority, activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Illusionist's Bracers' trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Illusionist Bracers' trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Illusionist's Bracers' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Illusionist's bracers' trigger twice.
Repeat from step 5.

1594-2034-4871-6005-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

955-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
955-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

1418-1651-2638-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-2638-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-2638-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6705-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate two Insect and Frog by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

38-3705-4871-6896.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

3239-5147-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2034-2558-3490-4779-6701.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-4779-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2577-5231-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

186-2060-2313-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-2313-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

803-3951-5231-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
803-3951-5231-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1978-2364-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Mana Vault that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.

293-5220-5231-5716.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Narcomoeba, adding {R}.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1863-2315-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3430-3812-4289.notablePrerequisites: Simic Ragworm does not have summoning sickness.
3430-3812-4289.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

341-3321-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

77-570-747-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder and Go-Shintai do not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Shrine.
You control a black and a red permanent.
77-570-747-1636.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing another nontoken Shrine, causing you to gain life equal to the Shrine's mana value.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning any Shrine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Shrine enters the battlefield, triggering Go-Shintai, creating a 1/1 Shrine enchantment creature token.
The Shrine token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1738-3173.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1738-3173.description:
Cast Fling by paying {1}{R} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, dealing damage equal to Serra Avatar's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

3525-3664-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
3525-3664-4644.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
